npcLines: Good afternoon. Welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation?
Hello! Welcome. Have you booked a room with us?
turns.translation: Chào buổi chiều. Chào mừng đến khách sạn. Bạn đã đặt phòng chưa?
accepted: Yes, I have a reservation under the name Linh
Yes, I have a booking under the name Linh
Yes, I booked a room online
turns.hint: Try: Yes, I have a reservation under my name.

npcLines: Thank you. How many nights will you be staying?
Great. How long are you staying with us?
turns.translation: Cảm ơn bạn. Bạn sẽ ở lại mấy đêm?
accepted: I will be staying for three nights
I will stay for three nights
turns.hint: Try: I will be staying for three nights.

npcLines: Your room is on the fifth floor. Would you like breakfast included?
Room five hundred and twelve. Do you want to add breakfast?
turns.translation: Phòng của bạn ở tầng năm. Bạn có muốn bao gồm bữa sáng không?
accepted: Yes, what time is breakfast served
Yes, please. What time is breakfast
turns.hint: Try: Yes, what time is breakfast served?
